LESSON: INTRODUCTION TO CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: FOUNDATIONS OF CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outc
Topic 1.1: Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are the categories of the Creative Arts and Sports related?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe categories of Creative Arts and Sports
2. appreciate the categories of Creative Arts and Sports

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: INTRODUCTION TO CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: INTRODUCTION TO CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Study Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe categories of Creative Arts and Sports

What this means
In this part you learn to describe categories of Creative Arts and Sports. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe categories of Creative Arts and Sports.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe categories of Creative Arts and Sports. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the categories of Creative Arts and Sports

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the categories of Creative Arts and Sports. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the categories of Creative Arts and Sports.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the categories of Creative Arts and Sports. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe categories of Creative Arts and Sports)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports in your own words. (skill: appreciate the categories of Creative Arts and Sports)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe categories of Creative Arts and Sports.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the categories of Creative Arts and Sports.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are the categories of the Creative Arts and Sports related?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe categories of Creative Arts and Sports.
5. Be able to: appreciate the categories of Creative Arts and Sports.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
